operating_notes.text: Kotak Mahindra Bank approved acquiring loan portfolio and non-treasury investments of ₹10,639 Cr from wholly-owned subsidiary Kotak Mahindra Investments Limited in Q2FY27.
Borrowings include ~₹15,800 cr raised during the quarter in Bank's international branches.
Net Advances include loans against FCNR(B) deposits ~₹16,110 cr by Bank's international branches.

timeline.summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank’s shareholders approved Mr. Ramesh G. Iyer’s appointment as Independent Director via remote e-voting on April 24, 2026, with requisite majority.
Kotak Mahindra Bank FY26 net profit rose to ₹19,181 Cr; consolidated PAT at ₹19,181 Cr

Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited’s Board of Directors, led by **Avan Doomasia** and **Kayomars Doomasia**, recommended a final dividend of Rs. 0.65 per equity share (face value Rs. 1) for FY2026, pending AGM approval.
Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd. uploaded the earnings conference call recording for FY2026 results on May 2, 2026.
Kotak Mahindra Bank board approved acquiring ₹10,639 Cr loan portfolio and non-treasury investments from wholly-owned subsidiary Kotak Mahindra Investments Limited.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹19,855.87 Cr (+15.4% YoY), net profit ₹5,645.38 Cr (+26.3% YoY).
Kotak Mahindra Bank reported Q2FY27 consolidated PAT of ₹5,645 Cr, up 26% YoY, while standalone NIM moderated to 4.31%.
Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited made the audio recording of the earnings conference call available on its website on October 24, 2026.
